verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's first-party Agents SDK, which runs on Workers and Durable Objects, lists built-in MCP support. The Think harness includes 'MCP tools' among its built-ins, and the mppx SDK handles payment retries for MCP tool calls made from agents, so agents built on Workers can consume external MCP servers' tools. The capability lives in the Agents SDK rather than the bare Workers runtime, and the server-side MCP fleet and probes are not relevant here. Missing for 10: explicit client-connection docs (how to register or connect a remote MCP server, transports, auth handling), hands-on or independent corroboration of MCP-client use.
